name: Sprint plan against capacity
summary: Before each planning meeting, the delivery lead or scrum master brings a draft plan for the next sprint: the days each person really has, a forecast from the team's own recent delivery, the carryover, the ranked backlog cut at that figure, and what each item waits on. The team decides the commitment.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of software engineering and project delivery work, and its own method for setting a ranked backlog against a team's availability and recent delivery.
